# llms.txt
# StudyShare — AI-powered college learning platform
# https://studyshare.in

## Overview
StudyShare is an AI-powered college learning platform for notes, PYQs, notices, syllabi, and campus communities.
Students join their college, find semester-wise resources, ask AI questions, and study faster.

## Key Features
- AI Study Assistant — ask questions from notes, PDFs, and web fallback
- Semester-wise Resources — notes, PYQs, videos, and downloads organized by branch and subject
- Department Notices — official updates from department accounts with search and date filters
- College Chatrooms — public rooms, join-by-code spaces, and community threads
- Study Timer — Pomodoro-style timer integration for focused study sessions
- Attendance Tracking — ERP sync for supported colleges (e.g., KIET)
- Mobile App — Android APK available for download

## Public Pages
- Homepage: https://studyshare.in/ — college selection and landing
- Blog: https://studyshare.in/blog — study tips, product updates, and college guides
- Mobile App: https://studyshare.in/mobile-app — Android app showcase and download

- Account Deletion: https://studyshare.in/account-deletion

## Content Policy
- All user-generated content is college-verified (email domain validation)
- Content moderation includes automated scanning and community reporting
- Copyright infringement reports handled via support@studyshare.in

## Contact
- Support: support@studyshare.in
